leveling_guide.description: Play generic strong early board. Save gold and maintain economy win or loss streak.
Level to 6 at Stage 3-2. Do not roll; prioritize reaching 50 gold safely.
Level to 7 at Stage 4-1. Roll down to find 2-star carry, then slow roll above 50 gold for 3-star.
Once core 3-star is secured, level to 8 to cap board with high-cost frontlines.
Slam flexible items on early item holders. Play for win streak or loss streak econ.
Level to 6 at Stage 3-2. Upgrade a couple 2-costs if weak, but stay above 30-40 gold.
Level to 8 at Stage 4-2. Roll down to find 4-cost core carries and frontline tanks.
Stabilize on 2-star 4-costs, then econ up to Level 9 for 5-cost legendary cap.
